value.rationale: Levene (2026) singles out J15 as a numerically promising but uncertified productive core and says only the tensor product example is proved. A rigorous rational certificate closes that concrete gap and gives a whole natural crown family, making the existing interval theorem applicable in a new structural setting. Exact n15 threshold is mathematical motivation, not an arbitrary slice; no exact norm or optimality claim is made.
